annotations.title: Latest results for a club, or the last round of a league

description: Form Guide. Latest results for a club, or the last round of a league. For requests like "how did Chelsea get on?" or "what were the Serie A results?". Without team or league, gives the Premier League.

league.description: One of: premier league, championship, la liga, bundesliga, serie a, ligue 1 (common variants like EPL or German Bundesliga work too). Any other league returns 404.

n.description: How many of the club's results, a whole number from 1 to 20. Default 5.

team.description: A club name, for example Liverpool or Real Madrid.

name: formguide_get_results
